project.name: CometGUI
project.description: Cross-platform JavaFX desktop application that runs a complete Comet to Percolator proteomics search workflow, installs every scientific tool it needs by itself, and produces a provenance record strong enough to reproduce the run later.

license.name: GNU General Public License v3.0 only

requireMavenVersion.message: CometGUI requires Apache Maven ${cometgui.minimumMavenVersion} or newer. Source tools/env.sh, or run scripts/feasibility/install-toolchain.sh if tools/ is missing.

requireJavaVersion.message: CometGUI requires a Java ${cometgui.minimumJavaVersion} JDK (pinned: BellSoft Liberica JDK 25.0.4.1+1, which bundles JavaFX). Source tools/env.sh.
